P180 (and P156), because merging these Claude-generated PRs with over 500,000 hallucinated line changes would cause massive harm to the repository. 2. D1, because enforcing the Quorum CI gate blocks emergency hotfixes with a 35-50 minute queue, defeating the purpose of the waived reason bypass. 3. D2, because the orchestrator's specified floor versions (v7.0.6 or v7.1.0) are already contradicted by reality since v7.1.0 shipped without the gates landing, requiring a spec update to v7.2.0+. These issues demonstrate that implementing the items as currently written would severely degrade CI responsiveness and corrupt the codebase.
